svg.title: Residents show Riju concrete benefits of the newly connected services.
svg.desc: At evening in Junction Square, different residents hold an accepted welfare token, clinic notification, and rail-range card. Babul has completed a medicine run, Ila listens, and Riju allows himself a moment of joy.
